question: Stamps are miniature gateways to the world because they:

options.text: give a lot of information about the place where they are issued
travel from one part of the world to another
are small in size and contain secret information
are found in every country across the globe

solution:
The correct answer is **'****give a lot of information about the place where they are issued.'**

***__Key Points__**

 
• Let's have a look at these sentences in the first paragraph of the passage: 
 
 
• ***' *Stamp collecting helps instruct the collector in geography, biography, history, culture and art. Stamps are miniature gateways to the world.'**
 
• *​*It can be concluded from the above line that *stamps are miniature gateways to the world because they give a lot of information about the place where they are issued. (उपरोक्त पंक्ति से यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि टिकट दुनिया के लिए लघु प्रवेश द्वार हैं क्योंकि वे उस स्थान के बारे में बहुत सारी जानकारी देते हैं जहां उन्हें जारी किया जाता है।)
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
